purpose: A calm independent public UX showing which CoCivium services run without chat relay and which effects still need real receiver authority.
scope: Bounded, dated public-source and GitHub Actions observations, not a live authoritative CoAll operating state

proofs.title: Public first-use pages
proofs.effect: Bounded public publication and browser tasks; no private service control

proofs.title: Candidate fan-in
proofs.scope: 12/12 no-effect safety cases, five existing bubble WorkIDs
proofs.effect: Only classification and local test receipts

proofs.title: Portable offline first task
proofs.scope: 2/2 no-network-before-navigation browser viewports, SHA-256 tamper control
proofs.effect: Local file can recover after archive delivery; not independent second host

proofs.title: Existing scheduled CoGoAll source check
proofs.scope: Source artifact checked by a different hosted job; receiver_ack:false
proofs.effect: Job-boundary source check only, no X2 receiver

proofs.title: CoNexus cross-run proof
proofs.scope: Different GitHub run verifies earlier source receipt; external effects 0
proofs.effect: Source readproof across runs on one provider, not device pickup

proofs.title: Actual independent WorkID useful effect
proofs.scope: X2/CoStead origin ACK, effect and no-change/changed-source sequence unproven
proofs.effect: No live effect may be inferred

proofs.title: Independent provider survival
proofs.scope: Cold first-use after GitHub inaccessible, distinct host, RTO/RPO unproven
proofs.effect: Portable capsule alone cannot prove federation

proofs.title: Human first-use acceptance
proofs.scope: Real unaided person finds status, useful task and Stop; not measured
proofs.effect: Browser automation is not a human user study

modes.label: Normal public checks
modes.meaning: Public-hosted read-only audits and first-use pages need no persistent chat tab.
modes.next: Check the latest hosted run; classify additional work only if useful.

modes.label: The chat disappears
modes.meaning: Only previously committed WorkIDs and artifacts can be recovered. Unsubmitted thoughts do not magically survive.
modes.next: Rebind from durable exact sources, not chat history.

modes.label: Nobody answers
modes.meaning: Harmless authorized checks continue at their own existing wakes. Money, privacy and irreversible acts remain gated.
modes.next: Complete safe work or sleep; do not page a human for no change.

modes.label: Effect occurred, ACK missing
modes.meaning: No blind retry. Verify the external state and idempotency token before choosing recovery.
modes.next: Reconcile from the independent effect receiver and preserve conflict.

modes.label: Two writers disagree
modes.meaning: Preserve both candidates, challenge sources, and elect one authorized actor per collision domain.
modes.next: Reject last-write-wins and keep unrelated safe work running.

acceptance_next.scope: Existing CoOwnedWork #450 and CoRelationalAutocycle #266 owner lanes
acceptance_next.proof_requirement: One changed-input and one no-change wake, source completeness, fenced lease, real harmless effect, independently produced exact receiver ACK, replay/restart and user-touch count
acceptance_next.prohibited_shortcut: Do not count GitHub CI or X2 agent connectivity as real CoStead or native CoBar acceptance.

privacy: No user input collection or automatic off-site API calls. A manual refresh may request public GitHub Actions status if visitor chooses.
